issues.description: Method getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): The UML diagram in problem_statement.md declares getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() with return type void (UML: line 71), while the textual task description in problem_statement.md (lines 43-45) explicitly says it should return a String in the format "LectureName (TotalNumberOfStudents)". The provided solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) implements getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() returning String (signature at line 80). This contradictory specification (UML vs. text & solution) can confuse students about the correct method signature to implement and may lead to compilation or grading inconsistencies.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification consistent. Recommended: update the UML in problem_statement.md so the method is declared as +getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): String to match the textual description and the solution implementation. If the intended design is a void method instead, update the textual task description and the solution implementation accordingly (and provide guidance on how the result should be produced, e.g., printed). Ensure the UML, textual description, and reference solution all use the same return type.
